title: Methane dry reforming reference family
objective: Optional literature-backed thermal-catalyst family for methane dry reforming screening. These routes emphasize the tradeoff between non-noble economics, coke resistance, and high-temperature route maturity.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance catalyst cost, evidence quality, route maturity, and performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward current catalyst cost while preserving evidence and route guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward transparent inputs and more defensible preparation routes.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2019
citations.note: Atomically dispersed nickel route demonstrating coke-resistant DRM activity on ceria-derived supports.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2023
citations.note: Coke-free DRM framework emphasizing balanced elementary-step kinetics rather than only maximizing methane activation.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2024
citations.note: Ir@CeO2-x interfacial route with strong activity and coke suppression under DRM conditions.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2024
citations.note: Nickel-zeolite route showing how tuned metal-support interactions materially improve DRM stability.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2025
citations.note: Ce-modified Ni-exsolved perovskite route with strong CH4 and CO2 conversion plus long-term robustness.

citations.label: Applied Catalysis A 1995
citations.note: Ruckenstein & Hu: foundational study of CO2 reforming of methane over nickel/alkaline-earth metal oxide catalysts; alkaline-earth additives mitigate coke deposition.

citations.label: Chem. Soc. Rev. 2014
citations.note: Pakhare and Spivey: foundational review of dry (CO2) reforming of methane over noble-metal catalysts, covering mechanism, deactivation, and support effects.

citations.label: Science 2016
citations.note: Buelens, Galvita et al.: super-dry reforming of methane intensifies CO2 utilization by coupling Ni catalysis with a CaO/Fe2O3 redox cycle.

route_templates.name: Ni single-site ceria route
route_templates.route_note: High-value non-noble route when coke resistance matters more than absolute simplicity.

route_templates.name: Ni-zeolite stabilized route
route_templates.route_note: More transferable than single-atom routes while still focusing heavily on metal-support interaction control.

route_templates.name: Ir-CeO2-x premium route
route_templates.route_note: Premium DRM route used when activity and anti-coking performance justify noble-metal exposure.

candidates.title: Ni/CeO2 single-site route
candidates.summary: Low-loading nickel route that uses oxygen-storage support engineering to suppress coke during DRM.
decision_notes: Strong non-noble DRM route when catalyst replacement and carbon management both matter.
Single-site or highly dispersed preparation keeps route maturity below simpler Ni-supported baselines.

pricing.note: Live nickel feed with precursor markup for low-loading deposition.
2025 USGS cerium-oxide price used as a bulk support/promoter proxy.

candidates.title: Ni-zeolite stabilized route
candidates.summary: Nickel route that leans on structured support interactions rather than noble-metal loading to improve DRM stability.
decision_notes: Best fit when you want a more transferable non-noble DRM route than single-site Ni while still improving stability.
Support engineering is the main route premium rather than raw-metal exposure.

pricing.note: Live nickel feed with precursor markup.

Structured zeolite support term retained as a conservative engineering proxy pending a cleaner public bulk quote. Bracketed by USGS natural zeolite ($200/t 2024 average ex-works, ~$0.09/lb) and the UN Comtrade synthetic-silicate import average ($4.07/kg, ~$1.85/lb).

candidates.title: Ir@CeO2-x premium
candidates.summary: Low-loading iridium route for DRM when anti-coking performance is worth a noble-metal premium.
decision_notes: Performance leader for this family, but noble-metal exposure is hard to justify unless coking limits dominate economics.
Use as a premium benchmark rather than a default procurement basis.

pricing.note: Ir reference feed with a mild precursor markup for very low-loading deposition.
2025 USGS cerium-oxide price used as a bulk oxygen-storage support proxy.
